question: In classical Carnatic music, tempo is called as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**laya**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Laya** is the term used in **classical Carnatic music **to refer to tempo.
 
• It is a fundamental concept that governs the speed and rhythm of the musical performance.
 
• The tempo in Carnatic music can be broadly classified into three categories: **Vilambita (slow), Madhyama (medium), and Druta (fast)**.
